meta_description: Check availability and request a booking of the Geneva Solution Space ground floor or Fab Lab.

spaces.label: Ground Floor
spaces.description: The 330 m² ground-floor space: up to 60 seated, 90 standing, with kitchen, projection wall and hybrid AV. Managed by the University of Geneva.
spaces.alt: The ground-floor space during a session

spaces.label: Fab Lab
spaces.description: Prototyping workshop with 3D printing, laser cutting, CNC milling, and vinyl cutting. Managed by AddictLab in cooperation with the University of Geneva.
spaces.alt: The laser cutter in the Fab Lab

form.intro: Pick a space, a day and the hours you need. Your slot is held while we review your request.

items.term: How far in advance should I book?
items.text: Submit your request as early as possible, especially for multi-day events, and indicate if you need partner support for event facilitation or use of the Fab Lab. We'll confirm availability and pricing before you commit.
150 CHF/hr, 1500 CHF/day. Half-price for first-time users (max one day).

booking.confirmation_note: Your request is held for you while we review it. We usually reply within two working days.
